title: Misalignment of Low-Loss Regions Causes Grokking
abstract: arXiv:2610.00620v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Grokking refers to the delayed emergence of validation-set generalization after a model has already overfit the training set. Although first observed in small algorithmic tasks trained with transformers, its underlying mechanism remains unsettled. In this work, we develop an analysis framework based on mode connectivity and the geometry of low-loss regions. The framework predicts that the standard modular-arithmetic setting does not always produce grokking: under a symmetry-preserving train/validation split, we observe a stable anti-grokking case in which validation performance does not recover. This counterexample challenges several existing correlational explanations of grokking. More broadly, our analysis framework and results further suggest that grokking arises when the low-loss regions induced by the training and validation partitions are misaligned. translated_title: 低损失区域的错位导致Grokking（顿悟）现象
translated_abstract: Grokking是指模型在已经过拟合训练集之后，验证集泛化能力延迟出现的现象。尽管该现象最早在使用Transformer训练的小型算法任务中被观察到，但其底层机制至今仍无定论。在本工作中，我们开发了一个基于模式连通性与低损失区域几何结构的分析框架。该框架预测标准的模运算设定并不总是产生grokking现象：在保持对称性的训练/验证集划分下，我们观察到一个稳定的反grokking案例，其中验证集性能始终未能恢复。这一反例对现有的若干关于grokking的相关性解释提出了挑战。更广泛地说，我们的分析框架和结果进一步表明，当训练集划分与验证集划分所诱导的低损失区域发生错位时，grokking现象便会出现。一旦这些区域充分对齐，仅凭训练超参数就无法……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文提出基于模式连通性与低损失区域几何的分析框架，指出grokking现象源于训练集与验证集所诱导的低损失区域之间的错位，并以稳定的反grokking反例挑战了现有的相关性解释。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an analysis framework based on mode connectivity and the geometry of low-loss regions, showing that grokking arises from misalignment between the low-loss regions induced by training and validation partitions, and presents a stable anti-grokking counterexample that challenges existing correlational explanations.
